content.name: Essence of Ether
entries: A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 8 hours. The {@condition poisoned} creature is {@condition unconscious}. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

content.name: Essence of Ether
entries: A creature subjected to Essence of Ether must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 8 hours. The creature also has the {@condition Unconscious|SRD52} condition while {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
